content: A single stone in the wall of the caravanserai is neither king nor slave, yet without it, the roof collapses.
author: Persian Proverbs
explanation: We spend our lives agonizing over whether we are celebrated enough, famous enough, or important enough. In the great shelter of civilization, every honest, dependable person is a keystone in the wall. Stand faithfully in your place and hold up the roof.
practicalInsight: Fulfill your humble role with absolute dependability today, knowing that the structural integrity of your team relies on you.
reflectionPrompt: Are you belittling your own value because you are not the decorative dome, forgetting that you hold the foundation?
